steps: The project animation starter previews every exact script byte. Its command and time parameters, selected path and existing character document type persist in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px; the final source line is reachable by scrolling. Return/Create/Cancel remain visible. Cancel changes no editor state or author files.

Create script opens the normal TXT source draft and focuses its editor without any file or registration write. Ordinary Save stores the reviewed GDScript bytes under the existing character type, adds only source plus registration, and immediately makes that source visible to the existing behavior source directory.

The real Build panel plans, generates and runs an assembled project in Godot. Four executed pause/seek/play/stop receipts expose execution phase and separate scene/playhead times. The independent view retains state/event/audio histories and displays the real ledger in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px without horizontal overflow.

Separate read-only controls open the frozen behavior declaration and animation declaration at their own registered source paths. Runtime execution and source navigation leave all author files unchanged after the single deliberate TXT save.
